introduction.title: What are Claude agents at TenthMatrix?
introduction.content: Claude agents are Anthropic’s productised ways to plan, use tools, and finish multi-step work — not one-shot chat replies. Engineering teams live in Claude Code. Ops and knowledge teams use Claude Cowork. Builders embed the Claude Agent SDK with subagents and dynamic workflows. TenthMatrix maps each surface to owners, risk classes, and promotion paths so demos become durable operating models.
keyPoints: Claude Code: Terminal and IDE coding agents for repo-scale edits, tests, PRs, and long-running tasks
Claude Cowork: Desk-to-phone business workflows for decks, docs, spreadsheets, and scheduled work
Subagents: Named workers with isolated context and restricted tools for focused subtasks
Dynamic workflows: Claude-written orchestration scripts that fan out, verify, and synthesise at scale
Governance: MCP OAuth, Vault leases, human approval gates, and Ring Promoter health-gated deploys

faq.question: How is Claude Code different from Claude chat?
faq.answer: Claude chat answers questions. Claude Code is an agentic coding product that reads your repo, edits files, runs commands, and completes multi-step engineering work in the terminal or IDE — including headless Dispatch for automation.

faq.question: What are Claude subagents?
faq.answer: Subagents are separate agent instances the main agent can spawn for focused work. You define them in the Agent SDK or as markdown files under .claude/agents/, give them clear descriptions and tool allowlists, and Claude delegates when the description matches.

faq.question: When should I use dynamic workflows instead of subagents?
faq.answer: Use a few subagents for adaptive delegation inside a conversation. Use dynamic workflows when you need dozens of workers, repeatable orchestration in a script, and verification passes that should not overflow the main context window.

faq.question: What is Claude Cowork for?
faq.answer: Cowork targets business and knowledge work — decks, docs, spreadsheets, scheduled tasks — with connectors and automatic parallelisation. It is the non-terminal sibling of the same agent architecture as Claude Code.

faq.question: How does TenthMatrix help with Claude agents?
faq.answer: We map the right Claude surface to each team, secure MCP tools with OAuth and Vault leases, put WSL Proxy in front of agent traffic, and promote changes through Ring Promoter rings so agent demos survive production.
